storyTitle: Ready for your perfect day in paradise?
storyTagline: Tell us the day, the group and the vibe — we’ll handle the rest, from hotel pickup to the last sunset.

content.text: Red mud, jungle trails and a cenote waiting at the end of the road. Our boogies and Polaris tours leave the resort zone behind and head straight into the countryside — helmets on, engines loud, a cold swim as the reward.
Speedboat out, catamaran home. Saona, Catalina and the natural pools of Cotubanamá National Park — starfish under your feet, lunch on the sand and the music turned up for the ride back.
The first city of the Americas: the Colonial Zone, the Alcázar de Colón, cigars, cacao and merengue. A day of the Dominican Republic the resorts never show you.
